title: Harmonic Circuit: Chord Progression Lies in a Sparse Principal Information Flow in Symbolic Music Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24453v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mechanistic Interpretability (MI) seeks to decode neural network computations into human-understandable logic. A core methodology in MI is circuit discovery: identifying the information flow in sub-networks that drive specific model behaviors. While circuit discovery has matured within Natural Language Processing (NLP), the interpretable circuits in music models remain largely unexplored. In this work, we identify a music-functional circuit within two symbolic music generative models: ChatMusician and MuPT. The music function we consider is the prediction of the terminal tonic root in a classical harmonic progression pattern $I \ldots V \rightarrow I$. We use the Auto-Emergence algorithm to extract a principal sparse sub-network as the identified circuit. translated_title: 和声电路：和弦进行蕴含于符号音乐模型的稀疏主信息流中
translated_abstract: 机制可解释性旨在将神经网络的计算过程解码为人类可理解的逻辑，其核心方法之一是电路发现：识别驱动特定模型行为的子网络中的信息流。尽管电路发现技术在自然语言处理（NLP）领域已经趋于成熟，但音乐模型中的可解释电路仍在很大程度上未被探索。在本工作中，我们在两个符号音乐生成模型 ChatMusician 和 MuPT 中识别出一个具有音乐功能的电路。我们考虑的音乐功能是对经典和声进行模式 I…V→I 中终止主和弦根音的预测。我们使用 Auto-Emergence（自动涌现）算法提取出一个主要的稀疏子网络作为所识别的电路。通过因果干预进行的验证证实，该电路是符号音乐模型中和声进行行为的主要驱动因素。据我们所知，这一研究是……
tldr: 首次在符号音乐生成模型（ChatMusician 与 MuPT）中进行电路发现，识别出驱动和声进行 I…V→I 行为的一条稀疏主信息流电路，并通过因果干预验证其作用。
en_tdlr: This work pioneers circuit discovery in symbolic music generative models, identifying a sparse principal information-flow circuit in ChatMusician and MuPT that causally drives the harmonic progression behavior I…V→I.
